data.summary: The pod startup was dominated by a 48.954-second image pull, which accounted for over 94% of the total 52.0-second startup time. The image size of 648 MB is the primary cause of the delay, as application initialisation and readiness checks were completed efficiently.

findings.statement: The image pull phase took 48.954 seconds to download a 648 MB image.
The image pull accounted for 94% of the total startup duration.
Application initialisation and readiness phases were fast, taking 1.089 seconds and 0.691 seconds respectively.

ruled_out.reason: Application initialisation was completed in only 1.089 seconds.
Scheduling took 0.0 seconds, indicating no resource or scheduling constraints.
The readiness probe completed in 0.691 seconds, which is well within normal limits.

recommendations.rationale: The 648 MB image size is the primary bottleneck for cold starts, causing a 48.954-second delay.
